description: Swap one card of a deck list for another, keeping its count and section: the row want_id is cut and `replacement` is added. Typical use: a missing card and a pick from find_substitutes. Copies the deck held of the old card are released (listed under `released`; sleeved ones return to "Unsorted"). Nothing is claimed for the new card — the returned row shows its coverage (claimable = you own a free copy); run claim_from_collection to claim it.

replacement.description: The card that takes its place

name.description: Card name in English or any language Scryfall prints ("Blitzschlag", "Foudre", "稲妻"), used when scryfall_id is absent; an English name is also fuzzy-resolved via Scryfall

scryfall_id.description: Exact Scryfall printing id, if known

name: replace_card
title: Replace card
